tool_input.description: Read George's inbox and task board

result:
Awake. Nothing in the record changed since my watermark: `office.mjs index` rebuilt it at the same commit (`e1a41db`, 142 decisions, 52 open risks of 57) with every record file at the same line count (`status.md` 4501, `whats-done.md` 10125, `decisions.md` 4949, `CLAUDE.md` 1073), `git log e1a41db..HEAD` is empty, and the only diff against that commit is the still-uncommitted office work in `status.md` and `whats-done.md` (the three 2026-10-27 "AI employees" entries at `whats-done.md:10094–10124`, and the Next up paragraph ending "Next: q11 and q12, then Phase 3"), which my `owed.md` already carries (line 45 and the ideas table, lines 89–91).

To find that out I read `notes/README.md` and the old `watermark.json`, ran `inbox george` (empty), `task list george` (empty), `index`, `git log --oneline e1a41db..HEAD`, `git diff --stat` and the full `git diff` of the record files, `git status --short` (uncommitted: `.claude/settings.json`, `package.json`, `status.md`, `whats-done.md`; untracked: `.claude/agents/`, `office/`, `plan/ai-employees.md`, `plan/ai-employees/`), and a grep of `owed.md` for q11/q12; inbox acked (nothing to ack). No digest needed amending; the open item the record names next is still the user's: q11 (names) and q12 (the first idea), then Phase 3, plus Python and the three `/mcp` logins (`status.md` Next up; `whats-done.md:10124`).
